# Referee-facing novelty statement

The paper combines known heat-kernel, center, and conditional-probability ingredients into a theorem with a distinct quantifier and conclusion. It constructs an admissible local central staple pattern on an open hypercubic block, derives the exact compact-group one-link conditional large-deviation rate, identifies the complete minimizing set without a geodesic-uniqueness assumption, proves an exact target-good exponent and open positive-measure stability, and uses `m` private opposite links to force failure of the microscopic Dobrushin row criterion. The closest center-flux literature studies global twisted sectors and retains their free-energy cost; the closest conditional literature states general criteria but does not evaluate this gauge specification; constructive RG does not impose the invalidated worst-boundary estimate. The claim is therefore a finite-lattice obstruction to a proof mechanism. It is not novelty of center frustration itself and is not a continuum, confinement, or mass-gap result.
